form:FormGroup.label: Select the parent folder
form:FormGroup.helpText: The folder to create the new item in.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the new item. Folder names may only contain letters, numbers, spaces and _ - . ( ).
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Folder names: letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, hyphens, full stops, brackets only.

form:FormGroup.label: Permissions
form:FormGroup.helpText: Sets the permissions of the new item. None: no permissions are added. Destination: the parent folder's permissions are copied. You always become an owner. Default is Destination.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: You become an owner. Default is Destination.
